notes.title: MEGA UPDATE: Parkour Labs NOW in Unreal Engine 5
notes.notes:
Now you can Play Parkour Labs on the official port on Unreal Engine 5, why Unreal Engine 5? Easy, better platform support, consoles, phones, etc

FEATURES:
- Better Jumps when you are failing
- Improvement Controls

BUGFIXES:
- Tiny bugs in the menus 


In a future, i will upload an update with a better difficult curve.

Thanks for all and no forget to leave a positive review on Steam

SoyKhaler

notes.title: Parkour Labs BIG UPDATE: Remind your level and Sensitivity
notes.notes: The community had asked me to add a system to remind you of the levels you had already completed, and a system to change the sensitivity on the mouse and gamepad. After a week of hard work, here it is. In less than two weeks, you will have another update fixing the difficulty curve of certain levels. In short, we are going to improve the order in which the levels increase in difficulty. Thank you very much for being there, and if you are enjoying Parkour Labs, don't forget to leave a positive review on the Steam page. It helps us a lot.
